title: Reference Terraform modules for Private Service Edges on AWS and Azure
aliases: terraform aws private service edge module
terraform azure private service edge module

prose.text: The reference modules deploy Private Service Edge VMs and wrap the group resource.

prose.label: Group wrapper.
prose.text: {{wrapper-defaults}} Grace distance and DR mode are not exposed {{gap:wrapper-omits-grace-dr}}.

prose.label: Not quoted.
prose.text: The AWS network and IAM resources are unverified {{gap:aws-security-iam}}, as is the example catalog {{gap:example-catalog}}.

checks.do: Which instance type or size the module deploys, since the AWS and Azure defaults differ.
Which onboarding method the module used; both default to OAuth2 user codes.
Whether the group wrapper sets grace distance or DR mode, which it does not expose.

aws-instance-type.statement: The AWS Private Service Edge VM module defaults to m5.large and validates the type against t3.xlarge, m5.large, m5.xlarge, m5.2xlarge and m5.4xlarge.

aws-asg-defaults.statement: The AWS Auto Scaling Group module defaults to a minimum of 2, a maximum of 4 and a 50 percent average-CPU target.

quotes:
description = "Mininum number of Service Edges to maintain in Autoscaling group"
  default     = 2

description = "Maxinum number of Service Edges to maintain in Autoscaling group"
  default     = 4

description = "Target value number for autoscaling policy CPU utilization target tracking. ie: trigger a scale in/out to keep average CPU Utliization percentage across all instances at/under this number"
  default     = 50

azure-instance-size.statement: The Azure Private Service Edge VM module defaults to Standard_D4s_v3 and validates the size against Standard_D2s_v3, Standard_D4s_v3 and Standard_F4s_v2.

azure-vmss-defaults.statement: The Azure VMSS example defaults to a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 10 Private Service Edges.

quotes:
description = "Minimum number of Private Service Edges in the scale set."
  default     = 2

description = "Maximum number of Private Service Edges in the scale set."
  default     = 10

aws-oauth-default.statement: The AWS modules default to OAuth2 user-code onboarding, relaying each VM's code through AWS SSM Parameter Store, and require the ZPA Terraform provider 4.4.0 or later for it.

quotes: Each Service Edge boots, generates its OAuth2 user code (written to `/etc/issue` on the VM), and publishes the code to **AWS SSM Parameter Store**.
This module requires the ZPA Terraform provider `>= 4.4.0` for OAuth2 user-code onboarding.

azure-oauth-default.statement: The Azure VMSS example defaults onboarding_method to "oauth", relaying user codes through Azure Key Vault, and "provisioning_key" selects the legacy flow.

quotes: enrolls Service Edges via OAuth2 user codes relayed through Azure Key Vault.
\"provisioning_key\" uses the legacy provisioning key flow.

wrapper-defaults.statement: The AWS group wrapper defaults pse_group_enabled to true, pse_is_public to false, pse_group_upgrade_time_in_secs to "66600" and pse_group_override_version_profile to false.

quotes:
description = "Whether this Private Service Edge Group is enabled or not"
  default     = true

description = "(Optional) Enable or disable public access for the Service Edge Group. Default value is false"
  default     = false
Whether the default version profile of the Private Service Edge Group is applied or overridden. Default: false

wrapper-omits-grace-dr.title: Wrapper coverage of grace distance and DR mode
wrapper-omits-grace-dr.detail: A search of the group wrapper files of both modules for grace_distance and use_in_dr finds no match, so the wrappers do not expose those provider arguments. The absence rests on that search only; confirm against the current module release. Unverified legacy statement: operators needing them must extend the module or use the raw resource.
wrapper-omits-grace-dr.blocks: advising module users on grace distance or DR mode

aws-security-iam.title: AWS module security groups and IAM policy
aws-security-iam.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the security group module opens TCP/22, TCP/443 and UDP/443 from the VPC CIDR (or 0.0.0.0/0 when public), and the IAM module attaches an inline SSM policy granting PutParameter, AddTagsToResource, GetParameter and DeleteParameter on parameter/zpa/oauth-tokens/*. The module files were not quoted in this conversion. Resolve by reading modules/terraform-zspse-sg-aws and terraform-zspse-iam-aws.
aws-security-iam.blocks: firewall and permission guidance from the module

example-catalog.title: Example configurations shipped with the modules
example-catalog.detail: Unverified legacy statement: AWS examples base, base_pse, base_pse_asg, pse, pse_asg and Azure examples base, base_pse, pse, base_pse_vmss, pse_vmss, with greenfield or brownfield scope. Resolve by reading each examples/README.md.
